title: 240V含IMD+进口工业级器件
input: 请计算一个240V直流列头柜的MTBF。配置：输入2路500A断路器（2P），输出60路63A断路器（2P），防雷2组20kA 8/20μs，10寸触摸屏，含直流绝缘监测IMD，进口工业级器件，MTBF要求≥100,000h。请给出完整计算摘要。
expectedBehavior: 应正确使用进口工业级πQ=1.5，包含IMD器件的失效率计算，使用10寸HMI的λ值4.0000，计算结果应合理

expectations.description: Uses πQ=1.5 for import-grade (进口工业级) for all applicable components — MCBs, MOV surge protectors, Hall sensors, and relays — rather than the domestic default πQ=2.0.
Includes IMD (直流绝缘监测) as a discrete line item in SS2 with λ=1.6667×10⁻⁶/h, consistent with the 240V threshold rule.
Uses the 10-inch HMI failure rate λ=4.0000×10⁻⁶/h (from 250,000h MTBF), not the 7-inch value of 3.3333×10⁻⁶/h.
Hall sensor single-unit λ is 0.0150×10⁻⁶/h (λ_G=0.0100 × πQ=1.5 for import grade), not the domestic 0.0200.
Presents a two-subsystem breakdown separating SS1 (配电) and SS2 (监控) with individual λ subtotals, combined λ_total and MTBF result.
Final MTBF result is numerically greater than the domestic-grade reference of ~106,365h (because import πQ=1.5 lowers total λ), and explicitly states pass/fail judgment against ≥100,000h.
